Original_Form.Name: Humungousaur
Original_Form.About: A massive brown dinosaur-like Vaxasaurian with incredible strength and the ability to grow up to 60 feet tall.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Humungousaur
Ultimate_Form.About: Now green and armored, he cannot grow in size but his hands transform into Gatling-style maces that fire explosive bone missiles.

Original_Form.Name: Swampfire
Original_Form.About: A living plant with a fire-patterned head, capable of regenerating lost limbs and controlling plant life.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Swampfire
Ultimate_Form.About: A blue-flamed tree-stump entity. He is much tougher and shoots 'cold fire' which is far more destructive than normal fire.

Original_Form.Name: Echo Echo
Original_Form.About: A small, fragile alien that uses sound-based attacks and can duplicate himself infinitely.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Echo Echo
Ultimate_Form.About: A tall, blue, metal-based lifeform. He can no longer duplicate himself, but he uses high-tech Sonic Disks to devastate enemies.

Original_Form.Name: Big Chill
Original_Form.About: A moth-like alien from Kylmyys. He can freeze anything by breathing cold vapor or becoming intangible.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Big Chill
Ultimate_Form.About: Known as 'Cold Fire' Big Chill. He is red-colored and creates fire so cold that it freezes enemies faster than normal ice.

Original_Form.Name: Spidermonkey
Original_Form.About: A blue, four-armed monkey that can shoot webs from its tail and stick to any surface.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Spidermonkey
Ultimate_Form.About: A giant, purple, gorilla-like creature with six spider legs on its back. He is much stronger and shoots webs from his mouth.

Original_Form.Name: Cannonbolt
Original_Form.About: A round alien with organic armor. He can curl into a ball to roll at high speeds and deflect attacks.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Cannonbolt
Ultimate_Form.About: His shell turns light-blue and develops metallic spikes, turning him into a deadly, spiky wrecking ball.

Original_Form.Name: Wildmutt
Original_Form.About: A sightless beast that 'sees' through smell and sound, making him an expert tracker.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Wildmutt
Ultimate_Form.About: He gains the ability to speak, grows a spiked tail, and his senses become powerful enough to detect enemies miles away.

Original_Form.Name: Way Big
Original_Form.About: A massive entity born from cosmic storms. He is one of Ben's most powerful transformations.

Ultimate_Form.Name: Ultimate Way Big
Ultimate_Form.About: Grows even larger and gains a blue/red aesthetic. His cosmic rays become powerful enough to stop planet-destroying threats.
